item.title: Locals speak out on ammonia leak in Mason City
item.description: On Saturday, some residents in Mason City were evacuated from their homes due to an ammonia leak that made several blocks of the city unsafe.

item.title: Geneva's CERN hails delicate test on transporting antimatter as a scientific success
item.description: Scientists at CERN took some antiprotons out for a spin in a never-tried-before test drive. Tuesday's experiment was hailed as a success. About 100 antiprotons traveled in a truck around CERN's Geneva campus and were transported back into the lab. Each particle had corresponding antiparticle, like an antiproton, exactly matching the particle but oppositely charged. item.title: Heading to Bob Dylan's concert Tuesday in Rochester? Leave the camera at home.
item.description: Minnesota's own Bob Dylan is set to take the stage in Rochester on Tuesday night, expecting to draw a crowd -- but one thing that won't be in attendance is your cell phone.

item.description: A week after parting ways with Bob Motzko, the Minnesota Gophers have their next men’s hockey coach.

item.title: Sen. Boldon introduces bill to backfill canceled RPS federal education grant
item.description: On Tuesday, Senator Liz Boldon announced she has presented a bill to the Minnesota Senate Education and Finance Committee to fund a previously canceled federal grant for Rochester Public Schools.

item.title: Dodge County non-profit announces it has raised $30k for law enforcement
item.description: Over the weekend, the Dodge County Sheriff's Chaplains hosted their 1st Annual Law Enforcement Appreciation event. The organization announced it has raised about $30,000 in proceeds from the event.
